in2026_cea_average.label: Sensitivity — CO2-only grid (CEA FY2025-26 average, no CH4/N2O or upstream): understates grid emissions, so an upper bound on the EV saving
in2026_cea_average.description: Illustrative 2026-grid case using legacy ICCT 2021 vehicle assumptions. Electricity = CEA v22 FY2025-26 weighted average (CO2 only, busbar) grossed up for all-India T&D losses 17.63 % (FY2023-24). Petrol WTT/TTW = ICCT India gasoline blend (AR5 GWP100). Consumption = uniform over the two values ICCT supports. Battery = 68 kg CO2e/kWh (ICCT, China/India, AR5 GWP100). Maintenance included. NOT harmonized: grid is CO2-only (no CH4/N2O, no upstream) and the 2W production factor is on ICCT's 20-year-methane basis.

in2026_cea_operating_margin.label: Sensitivity — EV charging at CEA operating margin, CO2e (fossil-dominated proxy; not a guaranteed upper bound)
in2026_cea_operating_margin.description: Decision sensitivity, not a consequential LCA: EV electricity at the CEA FY2025-26 simple operating margin 0.963 kg CO2/kWh (excludes must-run hydro/nuclear/RE). A fossil-dominated proxy for added charging demand (not a guaranteed upper bound); a real marginal factor needs charging-time profiles and dispatch modelling.

in2026_cea_build_margin.label: Sensitivity — EV charging at CEA build margin, CO2-only (recent-capacity proxy; no CO2e adder: BM fuel mix unknown)
in2026_cea_build_margin.description: Decision sensitivity: EV electricity at the CEA FY2025-26 build margin 0.446 kg CO2/kWh (most recent 20 % of generation incl. RE) — indicates the direction of the grid, not a forecast.

in2026_petrol_e0.label: Sensitivity — petrol tailpipe as E0 fossil CO2 (IPCC 2006 defaults, no ethanol credit)
in2026_petrol_e0.description: Replaces the ethanol-blend tailpipe factor with IPCC 2006 E0 combustion CO2 (UNSD density): an upper bound for petrol tailpipe CO2. India's E20 blend needs its own WTW record (data gap).

in2026_avg_co2e.label: India 2026-grid, attributional — CEA FY2025-26 average on CO2e (AR5 GWP100, matching ICCT inputs), partial upstream (legacy 2021 ICCT vehicle data)
in2026_avg_co2e.description: Central decision case. Electricity = CEA v22 FY2025-26 average CO2 + combustion CH4/N2O (IPCC 2006 Tier 1) + coal-mine methane (India BUR-4 factors, CEA default heat rate, coal+lignite share 0.672), all at AR5 GWP100 (ICCT inputs are AR5; AR6 changes the grid factor by <0.01 %), grossed up for 17.63 % T&D losses. Still excludes mining energy, coal rail transport, gas supply chain and infrastructure. Petrol = ICCT India blend (AR5 GWP100). 2W production factor is on ICCT's 20-year-methane basis (flagged).

in2026_battery_replacement.label: Sensitivity — one battery replacement over the 120,000 km life (CO2e grid)
in2026_battery_replacement.description: Structural sensitivity: the ICCT assumption of no replacement is relaxed to one extra 2.9 kWh pack. Not evidence that a replacement occurs.

in2026_tx_losses.label: Sensitivity — grid gross-up by transmission-only losses (lower bound on technical losses) instead of all-India T&D incl. commercial
in2026_tx_losses.description: The central case allocates system emissions to billed electricity using T&D losses of 17.63 % (incl. commercial losses). This row uses regional transmission losses only (3.12-4.24 %), a lower bound on physical delivery losses.

in2026_om_co2_only.label: Sensitivity — CO2-only panel: CEA operating margin (compare with the CO2-only average and build-margin rows on one basis)
in2026_om_co2_only.description: Common-basis panel: average, operating margin and build margin all CO2-only, so the spread reflects the grid-accounting method alone.
